 It is used in managing health problems like Fever, Cough, Obesity, Blood cholesterol, High blood pressure, wound healing etc. 
 It belongs to Linaceae family and its latin name is Linum Usitatissimum . 
 COMMON SYNONYMS OF ALSI (LINUM USITATISSIMUM) 
 
 Alsi English name – Linseed, Flaxseed. 
 Alsi Hindi name – Alsi, Alasi, Teesi 
 Alsi Sanskrit name – Atasi, Neempushpi, Alasi, Kshuma, picchala, Neela, Neelapushpin. 
 Alsi Bengali name – Marshina. 
 Alsi Marathi Name – Javasu 
 Alsi Arabic name – Kattan 
 Alsi Gujarati – Alasi 
 Alsi Telugu name – Alasi, Atasi, Bittu

 Seeds of this plant are used to extract the famous Linseed oil and the stems are used for obtaining the fibre. Plant bears blue flowers and hence it name “Neela”. 
 The plants are rich sources of omega – 3 and omega – 6 fatty acids in addition to providing good dietary fibre. In addition EPA (eicosapentaenoic acid) DHA (Docosahexaenoic acid) which are very important for a healthy heart and brain function are also found in this plant. 
 ALSI PROPERTIES 
 
 Guna (Characteristics): Guru (Heavy), Snigdha (Smooth), Pichhil (Slimy Nature) 
 Rasa (Taste): Madhura (Sweet), Tikta (Bitter)
